notes.title: Chamberbound is taking part in Tiny Teams!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Chamberbound was officially selected for Tiny Teams and will be taking part in the event with a demo.

Make sure to check out all the other great games in the event after you try out the demo for Chamberbound! Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2024]here[/url] to go to the event page and see all the great games taking part in the event! Massive thanks to the Yogscast Games team for organizing the event and selecting us!

Don't forget to wishlist Chamberbound!

notes.title: Try Our Demo at Puzzle Fest!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that Chamberbound is participating in Steam Puzzle Fest 2023! During the festival, you will have the chance to experience Chamberbound for yourself with the latest demo of the game.

Steam Puzzle Fest celebrates the spirit of solving puzzles and we are proud to be taking part in this festival.

The demo consists of 4 levels that show off the unique blend of puzzle and platforming Chamberbound offers.

Puzzle Fest runs April 24 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to May 1 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7). So make sure you check out Chamberbound and other great games in the event.

We hope you enjoy the demo! Don’t forget to wishlist Chamberbound!
